svg.title: Transept: plan · close-up in context
svg.desc: Plan of a cruciform church with the two arms of the cross (the transept) marked, crossing the nave at right angles in front of the choir and apse, and a round close-up of the crossing where the arms meet the nave and choir. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×3 · TRANSEPT ARMS 14 m LONG · 7 m WIDE · CROSSING 7 m SQUARE
CROSS ARMS OF A CRUCIFORM CHURCH

construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
